relations_to.summary: Finland sided with Denmark in the January 2026 Greenland crisis: Stubb set out three scenarios (off-ramp via NATO Arctic security, tariff war, military intervention), and Finnish officers studied how Finland could add to Arctic defence; no new troops were planned.

Stubb: Greenland is the hardest issue for Finland

relations_to.summary: Denmark and Sweden signed a joint CV90 procurement in December 2024 (about USD 2.5 billion, over 200 vehicles); in 2025 Finland, Norway, Lithuania, Estonia and the Netherlands joined the exploration of a wider CV90 group, with BAE expecting a record order in 2026.

sources.title: Denmark and Sweden sign $2.5 billion CV90 IFV joint procurement for over 200 vehicles
Exclusive: 4 Nordic nations in talks for joint procurement of infantry fighting vehicles
BAE braces for biggest-ever order of CV90 combat vehicle in 2026

relations_to.summary: In January 2026 Sweden, with France, Norway, Finland, Germany and the Netherlands, sent a small military contingent to Greenland at Denmark's request; Trump announced 10% tariffs on the eight countries (to 25% on 1 June) which he withdrew on 21 Jan after a 'framework' with NATO's Rutte.
